how_to_query:
WORKING AND VERIFIED 24 Sep 2026. Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC). Two endpoints, no auth, no cookies, no rate limiting hit across ~90 sequential calls.

STEP 1 - LIST ALL INDIA JOBS (India country facet ID = 300000000289360):
curl -s 'https://jpmc.fa.oraclecloud.com/hcmRestApi/resources/latest/recruitingCEJobRequisitions?onlyData=true&expand=requisitionList&finder=findReqs;siteNumber=CX_1001,limit=50,offset=0,sortBy=POSTING_DATES_DESC,selectedLocationsFacet=300000000289360' -H 'Accept: application/json' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0'
Paginate offset=0,50,100,...; read items[0].TotalJobsCount (=367) and items[0].requisitionList. Max page size is 50 (limit=200 is silently capped at 50). siteNumber CX_1001 and CX_1 return IDENTICAL data (367 both) - the endpoint hint's suggestion to try both is unnecessary.

HOW TO FIND LOCATION FACET IDs (these are the real verified ones):
curl -s 'https://jpmc.fa.oraclecloud.com/hcmRestApi/resources/latest/recruitingCEJobRequisitions?onlyData=true&expand=requisitionList&finder=findReqs;siteNumber=CX_1001,facetsList=LOCATIONS%3BWORK_LOCATIONS%3BCATEGORIES,limit=1,keyword=analyst' -H 'Accept: application/json'
 -> India 300000000289360 | Maharashtra 300000081134219 | Mumbai 300000081151360 | Karnataka 300000081134215 | Bengaluru 300000081145775

STEP 2 - FULL DESCRIPTION + VERBATIM QUALIFICATIONS. The finder is ById (NOT ByRequisitionId / ByPartyId / findReqDetailById - those all return HTTP 400) and the Id MUST be wrapped in literal double quotes:
curl -s -G 'https://jpmc.fa.oraclecloud.com/hcmRestApi/resources/latest/recruitingCEJobRequisitionDetails' --data-urlencode 'finder=ById;Id="210792898",siteNumber=CX_1001' -d 'expand=all' -d 'onlyData=true' -H 'Accept: application/json' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0'
CRITICAL GOTCHA: the whole job text lives in items[0].ExternalDescriptionStr (HTML). ExternalQualificationsStr and ExternalResponsibilitiesStr are EMPTY STRINGS on every single JPMC requisition - qualifications are embedded inside ExternalDescriptionStr, so do not skip parsing it. Also returns ExternalPostedEndDate (the real closing date).

DISCOVER VALID FINDERS FOR ANY ORC TENANT (this is how I found ById):
curl -s 'https://jpmc.fa.oraclecloud.com/hcmRestApi/resources/latest/recruitingCEJobRequisitionDetails/describe' | grep -oE '"name" : "By[A-Za-z]*"'

HUMAN APPLY URL (verified HTTP 200):
https://jpmc.fa.oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/CX_1001/job/<JOB_ID>

STUDENT-PROGRAMME SWEEP (how I proved India has zero):
curl -s 'https://jpmc.fa.oraclecloud.com/hcmRestApi/resources/latest/recruitingCEJobRequisitions?onlyData=true&expand=requisitionList&finder=findReqs;siteNumber=CX_1001,limit=50,offset=0,sortBy=POSTING_DATES_DESC,keyword=2027' -H 'Accept: application/json'
Paginate all 234 results, filter titles for summer analyst/internship/analyst program/graduate, then group by country.
student_programs:
HARD FINDING, VERIFIED FOUR WAYS: JPMorganChase currently has ZERO student / internship / graduate / analyst-development programme postings in India. Not "closed" - they do not exist on the public portal at all.

EVIDENCE 1 - full sweep of keyword "2027" across the GLOBAL feed (no location filter): 234 requisitions, of which 192 are student-type (title matching summer analyst / internship / intern / analyst program / analyst development / graduate / traineeship / off-cycle / development program). Country distribution of those 192:
United States 49, United Kingdom 37, Hong Kong 11, Singapore 11, France 9, China 9, Germany 8, Switzerland 6, UAE 5, Japan 5, Ireland 4, Spain 4, Netherlands 4, Sweden 3, Italy 3, Philippines 3, Taiwan 3, Turkiye 2, Belgium 2, Poland 2, Israel 2, Korea 2, Greece 1, Denmark 1, Luxembourg 1, Australia 1, Indonesia 1, Malaysia 1, Thailand 1, Saudi Arabia 1.
INDIA: 0. Filtering all 234 for PrimaryLocation matching India/Mumbai/Bengaluru/Bangalore/Hyderabad returns exactly 0 rows. Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand and Taiwan each have postings; India does not.

EVIDENCE 2 - keyword sweeps inside the India location facet: "Summer Analyst" -> 4 hits, "Internship" -> 10, "Intern" -> 200, "Campus" -> 82, "Emerging Talent" -> 7. Every single hit is an ordinary experienced-hire req (e.g. "FRRA International Reg Filings - Associate", "International Consumer Banking - Strategy - Vice President", "Credit Risk Associate"). The keyword is matching boilerplate body text ("internal", "international"), not a programme. Zero genuine student reqs.

EVIDENCE 3 - all 367 India requisitions have RequisitionType = null and JobSchedule = null (the fields JPMC uses to tag Intern/Campus/Part-time). The India feed carries no intern-tagged inventory whatsoever.

EVIDENCE 4 - https://www.jpmorganchase.com/careers/explore-opportunities/programs?country=India (careers.jpmorgan.com 301-redirects here) lists NO India-specific programmes; only generic "Early Insight / Internship / Full-Time" category tiles and a "Keep informed of when applications open" CTA.

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR OMKAR, CONCRETELY:
JPMC India does NOT run its campus pipeline through the public Oracle portal. India analyst/intern hiring happens through (a) on-campus placement cells at a fixed target-school list, and (b) the JPMorgan "Code for Good" hackathon, the firm's main India student funnel, which converts to Summer Analyst / Software Engineer Program offers. Neither appears in this feed. Therefore:
- Do NOT wait for an India Summer 2027 posting to appear on the portal. It very likely never will.
- The only two realistic India student routes are the DJSCE placement cell (he should ask the TPO directly whether JPMC recruits at DJSCE, in which cycle, and for which functions) and Code for Good (historically opens Jan-Mar; note it is engineering-framed, which cuts against his non-SDE preference, though analytics/D&A tracks do convert).
- TIMING PROBLEM REGARDLESS: JPMC's global 2027 Summer Analyst programmes are penultimate-year internships, i.e. for students graduating in 2028. Omkar graduates May 2027, so he is out of window for the 2027 summer intern class and is a FULL-TIME 2027-START candidate instead. The global full-time equivalents ("2027 ... Full-Time Analyst Program") are posted for US/UK/Singapore/Dublin/Toronto only - none in India.
- There is NO Jan-May 2027 final-semester internship at JPMC India. Zero. If he wants JPMC for his final semester it must come via the placement cell or a referral into an off-book arrangement.

NEAREST APAC STUDENT PROGRAMMES ACTUALLY OPEN (all non-India, all need relocation + work authorisation, all verified live in the feed):
- 210783022 "2027 Data & AI Program - Summer Internship - Singapore" (posted 2026-08-27) - closest title match to his profile anywhere in APAC.
- 210766489 "2027 Asia Analyst Development Program - Summer Analyst - Philippines" (2026-07-31).
- 210774277 "2027 Corporate Analyst Development Program - Summer Analyst - Philippines" (2026-08-31), plus 210754291 Singapore and 210753819 Hong Kong equivalents. CADP is the single best-fit JPMC programme in existence for an analytics-and-strategy student profile like his.
- 210774661 / 210774659 "2027 China Seasonal Internship Program - Asset Management - Business Analyst / Research Analyst" (Shanghai).
- 210761734 "2027 China Seasonal Internship Program - Research & Analytics".
Listed for completeness; visa and work-authorisation realistically make these long shots from India.

REFERRAL LEVERAGE - THIS IS WHERE THE REAL ANSWER IS: because India has no student pipeline at all, the ONLY way into JPMC India before June 2027 is an experienced-hire req taken on a waiver, and those reqs carry a hard "minimum X years" screen in the ATS. A referral here is not merely helpful, it is close to mandatory - it is the mechanism that gets a fresher CV past the years-of-experience auto-filter to a human reader. Prioritise referrals into the Mumbai reqs below that state NO years bar: 210792898, 210779109, 210786533, 210791098, 210761234, 210778334, 210792402, 210772979, 210732810. On those the written bar is skills-based and he meets most of it, so the referrer has an actual argument to make rather than asking for a favour.
limitations:
WHAT I COULD NOT ACCESS OR VERIFY, stated plainly.

1. NO INDIA STUDENT / INTERNSHIP / GRADUATE PIPELINE EXISTS ON THE PUBLIC PORTAL. This is a finding, not a tooling failure, and I verified it four independent ways (see student_programs). But it means I cannot hand him a single India internship or 2027 graduate-programme application, because JPMC publishes none. His real India student route runs through the DJSCE placement cell and/or Code for Good, neither of which is machine-readable and neither of which I could confirm dates for from an authoritative JPMC source. He must ask his TPO directly. Any claim that "JPMC India Summer 2027 applications are open" from aggregator sites (collegedunia, hirist, thenewviews, extern, prosple all surfaced in search) is UNVERIFIED third-party content and several of those pages contradict each other on the eligible graduation year. I did not use any of them as a source for anything above and he should not either.

2. NO SALARY OR COMPENSATION DATA. The Oracle feed exposes none for India requisitions and I did not substitute third-party estimates.

3. TWO REQUISITIONS HAVE NO PUBLISHED QUALIFICATIONS SECTION AT ALL. For 210732810 (Analyst - Credit Risk) and 210787200 (Business Analyst - Indirect Tax Operations), JPMC's own ExternalDescriptionStr ends without a Required qualifications block. I flagged this inside each entry and quoted only what actually exists rather than inventing a qualifications list. Treat years_required "not published" on those two as "not published", NOT as "no bar exists" - a recruiter screen will still apply one.

4. TWO REQUISITIONS ARE TRUNCATED MID-SENTENCE IN JPMC'S OWN FEED. 210792898 (Business Analysis Associate II) and 210789945 (Analyst - Data & Analytics) both cut off ("...improve accuracy in operational pr" and "Strong analytical and problem-solving s"). That truncation is in JPMC's published payload, not something I introduced; I marked it inline in both. The final words of those sections are unrecoverable from this endpoint.

5. I FETCHED FULL DETAIL FOR 67 OF THE 367 INDIA REQUISITIONS, NOT ALL 367. I filtered 367 down to 210 analytics/BI/risk/strategy/product candidates by title, then pulled full descriptions for a 67-role shortlist ranked by Mumbai location, Analyst-level title, and analytics relevance. It is possible a well-matched role sits in the ~143 India reqs I did not open - most were software engineering, infrastructure, sourcing, HR, audit, tax, or VP/ED/MD-level seats that the exclusion filters correctly removed, but I did not read every one. The reproducible commands in how_to_query let anyone re-run the full sweep.

6. LOCATION DATA HAS AT LEAST THREE ERRORS IN JPMC'S SOURCE. (a) Req 210776676 is titled "...-Bangalore" but its PrimaryLocation field says Hyderabad. (b) Req 210792863 is tagged PrimaryLocation Mumbai but its body says "Location: Pune, India" and describes Pune branch operations throughout - I excluded it from the final list for that reason. (c) One requisition returned inside the India location facet is a Wilmington, Delaware role and is not in India at all. Do not trust the location field absolutely; verify before travelling or relocating on the strength of it.

7. NO NAVI MUMBAI BREAKOUT IS POSSIBLE. JPMC's location facet has a single "Mumbai, Maharashtra, India" node (143 reqs, facet id 300000081151360). There is no separate Navi Mumbai facet, so I cannot tell him which of the 143 are Navi Mumbai versus city Mumbai. The Maharashtra-level facet count equals the Mumbai count (54 each on keyword=analyst), implying every Maharashtra role is Mumbai-tagged.

8. CLOSING DATES ARE PARTIAL AND SOME ARE IMMINENT. About half the reqs return a real ExternalPostedEndDate; the rest return null, which means open-ended rather than already closed. Several roles I ranked highly close within days of this research (today is 24 Sep 2026): 210788905 and 210788301 and 210791303 close 25 Sep; 210787644 closes 29 Sep; 210792402, 210786574, 210785595, 210789945, 210782110, 210787612 and 210776676 close 30 Sep; 210792898 closes 2 Oct; 210779109 closes 4 Oct. These will be stale quickly - re-run the detail call before acting on any of them.

9. I DID NOT VERIFY THAT ANY OF THESE REQS WILL CONSIDER A MAY-2027 GRADUATE, AND I DOUBT MOST WILL. Every role listed is an experienced-hire requisition wanting a joiner now, not in June 2027. Even the ones with no stated years bar are written for people already working. This is the central structural problem with JPMC for this candidate and no amount of endpoint access changes it: the firm has 367 open India roles and zero of them are structured for someone who cannot start for eight months. The honest read is that JPMC India is a referral-or-placement-cell target for him, not a portal target, and that the highest-value action here is not an application but two conversations - one with someone inside JPMC Mumbai, one with the DJSCE TPO about whether JPMC recruits on campus and in which cycle.

10. AI/GENAI LANGUAGE IS NOW BOILERPLATE AT JPMC AND I MAY BE OVER-CREDITING IT. Roughly a dozen of these reqs carry a near-identical bullet about "developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools". That phrasing is clearly templated across JPMC postings rather than a real team-by-team requirement. His GenAI/RAG/multi-agent work is genuinely differentiated, but he should not assume every req carrying that sentence actually weights it. The two where the AI content reads as real rather than templated are 210787644 (asks specifically for LLM API applications and conversational AI) and 210786528 (names LangChain, LangGraph, RAG and knowledge graphs explicitly). 210786574 is a third, weaker case (requires "creating rapid results with prompts in Large Language Models").

11. I COULD NOT CHECK WHETHER ANY OF THESE REQS ARE ALREADY FILLED OR ARE EVERGREEN PLACEHOLDERS. Several have been live since April-July 2026 with no closing date (210732810 since 7 Apr, 210732854 since 20 Apr, 210735064 since 14 Apr, 210702811 and 210758377 and 210761234 since 23 Jun). Long-dwelling reqs at large banks are frequently pipeline-building placeholders rather than live searches. The feed gives no signal to distinguish them, so treat old postings with lower expected response rates.

roles.title: Analyst US High Grade Strategy
roles.description_gist: US Credit Strategy team, Mumbai. The LOWEST explicit experience bar of any research/strategy seat in the India set at 1-3 years, and no posted closing date so it stays live. Strongly quantitative: multiple regression, econometric modelling, Python data manipulation, scenario analysis. His Statistics and Computational Finance coursework plus Python/pandas/scikit-learn cover the quant core, and 'fluency with AI-enabled tools to accelerate analysis' plus the NLP-for-research bullet are evidenced by LawzyAI and KOP AI. REAL BARRIER TO BE HONEST ABOUT: the final required bullet says "Master's degree or above in Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field from reputed institutions." He will hold a B.Tech, not a Master's. That is a stated requirement, not a preference, so this is referral-or-nothing - a referrer can argue 8.82 CGPA from DJSCE plus publication-quality analytical work, but the portal alone will screen him out. EDGE TO BUY IN 2-4 WEEKS: Bloomberg Market Concepts (free; Bloomberg proficiency is a required bullet), plus a refresher on multiple regression and time-series in Python statsmodels so he can speak to 'strong quantitative/econometric foundation (e.g., multiple regression)'. VBA appears only as 'plus Eviews/VBA where relevant' - low priority here.
